calculation.expression: -sum(return,3), activated when lagged VIX pct-change exceeds its trailing 60-day 75th percentile and lagged cross-sectional daily return dispersion exceeds its trailing 60-day 75th percentile; demean cross-section
calculation.description: Ranks assets for short-term reversal after simultaneous volatility-index shock and unusually high cross-asset dispersion. Signal uses only completed observations and is cross-sectionally demeaned.

validation.regime_notes: Joint activation is rare; 2020-22 IC -0.0952 across 12 observations, 2023-24 +0.0894 across 11, 2025-26 +0.1110 across 15, and 2027 YTD +0.2073 across 1. Small effective sample requires conservative interpretation.
